## 1. New LLM Versions / Major AI Lab Tools

- **Date:** 2026-06-09  
  **Source:** [Google — Gemini 3.5 Live Translate](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-live-3-5-translate/)  
  **Summary:** Google introduced Gemini 3.5 Live Translate for near real-time speech-to-speech translation across 70+ languages, preserving tone, pacing, and pitch. It is rolling out in Google Translate, public preview via Gemini Live API / AI Studio, and private preview for Google Meet enterprise customers.  
  **Why it matters:** Google is moving live multilingual voice translation from demo territory into product/API distribution.

- **Date:** 2026-06-09  
  **Source:** [Anthropic — Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-and-claude-mythos-5)  
  **Summary:** Anthropic released Claude Fable 5 broadly and restricted Claude Mythos 5 access to selected cyberdefenders and infrastructure providers through Project Glasswing. Some high-risk cyber, bio, chemistry, and distillation requests route to Opus 4.8 safeguards.  
  **Why it matters:** Anthropic is segmenting model access by risk profile, keeping higher-risk capability in controlled channels while shipping a public model variant.

## 2. FOSS / Open-Weight LMs & Tools

- **Date:** 2026-06-09  
  **Source:** [Hugging Face — Z.ai SCAIL-2](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/SCAIL-2)  
  **Summary:** Z.ai released SCAIL-2, an MIT-licensed image-to-video model for controlled character animation without intermediate pose or mask representations. The model card includes Diffusers usage examples plus project and paper links.  
  **Why it matters:** Open controlled animation models are becoming more deployable for character video workflows, reducing dependence on proprietary video tools.
